process.text: We learn your goals, users, and constraints, then agree on scope.
We shape the structure and interface before any build work starts.
We develop in small releases so you can review working software early.
We ship, monitor, and keep improving after go-live.

faq.a: Teridox is a web development and software agency. We build websites and web applications, cross-platform mobile apps, SaaS products, and AI integrations for growing businesses.

faq.q: How much does a website or app cost?
faq.a: The price depends on scope: number of pages or features, integrations, and design depth. Send us a short brief through the contact form and we reply with a quote for your project.

faq.q: How long does a web development project take?
faq.a: A focused landing page or company site is much quicker than a custom platform or SaaS product. We give a timeline after the discovery step, once the scope is clear.
React and Next.js for the web, React Native and Flutter for mobile, Node.js, Laravel, and PostgreSQL on the back end. We pick the stack that fits the project.

faq.q: Do you build iOS and Android apps?
faq.a: Yes. We build cross-platform apps that run on both iOS and Android from one codebase.

faq.q: Do you offer support after launch?
faq.a: Yes. Launch is not the end of the project: we monitor, fix, and keep improving the product after go-live.
